title: Advertising in Health Insurance Markets
eligible_reason: Border-discontinuity design with continuous treatment (brand and rival GRPs, ad stocks, occurrences) and time-varying plan/demographic/competition controls; UnitedHealthcare's unilateral ad cessation is a single national event analysed with continuous GRP regressions and a descriptive figure. No staggered binary adoption.
design_notes: all_code.do: reghdfe ma_pct grp rival_grp + plan/competition/demo controls, absorb(brand_border_year brand_fips), cluster brand_market (Table 4); category-level total_grp (Table 5); heterogeneity (Table 6); United share on total_grp 2008-2009 (Table 7); ad-stock regressions (Table 8). Figure 9 plots United share around the 2008-2010 cessation (common date).
data_files_note: CMS enrollment, contract and premium files shipped; Kantar advertising data replaced by a simulated extract (HI_bybrand0412_simulated.dta); county-DMA crosswalk not included.
data_provenance_note: Key advertising data are simulated under NDA (README).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ empty for this suffix); screened from README, code, data and the OpenAlex abstract. Continuous-treatment border design; out of scope.
